newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bank Bira closes US$80 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Bank Bira closes US$80 mln FRN.

text.p: Bank Indonesia Raya's US$80 million floating rate note issue has closed, arranger Merrill Lynch said on Monday.
The two-year facility is priced at par to float at 90 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 135 basis points.

Arranger and lead managers are Merrill Lynch Far East, American Express Bank, Arab Banking Corp Singapore, Banque Nationale de Paris Singapore, Dresdner SEA, First National Bank of Boston Singapore and Kangwon Bank.
Senior co-lead managers are Nomura International Hong Kong, PT Bank Espor Impor Indonesia and Daiwa Securities Hong Kong.
Co-lead managers are Kyungki Bank, Barclays Bank, Berliner Bank, Daedong Bank and Donghwa Bank.
Co-managers are Bank Austria Aktiengesellschaft Hong Kong, and Gyongnam Merchant Banking Corp.
